precepts.text: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth. Over one sinner that repents. You see that? The heavenly host, the angels, are happy when you change your life, when you get it together. Y'all understand that? Come on now. Give me Proverbs 11 again. It says there's joy. Joy. Isn't that a song? Joy and pain. Like sunshine. I can't sing. That ain't my lot. That ain't my lot. You ain't going to get me to sing. Nope. That ain't my gift. Go ahead, read this.
precepts.point: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven. Joy shall be in heaven. Read. Over one sinner that repenteth. Over one sinner that repented. Read. More than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance. Over ninety and nine just persons. Read verse 10.

note.label: Final Call: Message to the Black Man

precepts.why:
Christ says “joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance”, and then says it again: “Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.” The heavenly host, the angels, are happy when you change your life, when you get it together.

That is why we are weapons. “The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.” You have the potential to convert sinners, to have a brother or sister change his life, and that makes you dangerous. When one sinner repents, the angels rejoice.

How do you win a soul? Ultimately it is the word of God, but the Lord gave a secret: “By long forbearing is a prince persuaded”. We are fishers of men, on duty all day, handing out flyers even at a gas station, not waiting till Saturday or till you feel like it. But you have to be patient; you can't be brutish. Are you looking to win the argument or to win the brother or sister? Listen, study the person, wait for the moment. Don't take it personal when someone doesn't take the flyer; maybe next time. If you get mad now you close the door on them, and what if Christ had closed the door on you? Believe the information will do its job and let the Lord do his part, because no man can come unto Christ except the Father draw him.
